author: Matt Wolfe
description:
Meta dropped two updates last week:

1️⃣ Animate with Meta AI: You can now turn your profile pics and feed posts into animated moments. 
2️⃣ "Dear Algo" on Threads: You can now explicitly tell the algorithm what you want to see more (or less) of just by posting "Dear Algo:"

I just posted my algo request to the AI gods. I’ll report back if my feed actually gets better. 

#AI #AInews #meta #facebook #threads
title: Meta's New Social Media AI Features
